description: Acoustic guitar lessons designed for complete beginners.Students will start by learning the different parts of a guitar and proper hand positioning.The course then introduces basic chords, strumming techniques, and rhythm exercises. Through guided practice sessions, learners will gradually play simple songs and develop confidence in performing independently.

Interactive English speaking sessions for learners who want to improve communication skills. Participants will practice everyday conversations, expand vocabulary, improve pronunciation, and gain confidence in speaking English. Real-life scenarios and discussion activities help learners become more fluent and comfortable in conversations.

A beginner-friendly introduction to web development. Students will learn how websites are structured using HTML, styled with CSS, and made interactive with JavaScript. The course includes hands-on projects, responsive design concepts, and practical exercises to build a strong foundation in front-end development.

Learn the fundamentals of digital marketing and online brand promotion. This course covers social media marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), content creation, and audience engagement strategies. Students will also explore marketing analytics and campaign performance measurement
Create social media posts, presentations, and branding materials.
Improve confidence, presentation skills, and audience engagement.
Learn everyday cooking techniques and healthy recipes.
